topic: needn't have vs didn't need to

questions.explanation: 'Needn't have' means you did it but it was unnecessary.
'Didn't need to' means there was no need, whether you hurried or not.

options: You didn't need to cook so much — we've already eaten.
You needn't cook so much — we've already eaten.
You don't need have cooked so much — we've already eaten.
You needn't have cooked so much — we've already eaten.
questions.explanation: 'Needn't have' stresses the cooking happened but was unnecessary.
'Didn't need to' simply states there was no need to go.
'Needn't have' means the worrying happened but was pointless.
